leadText:
Volume 39: Renegade Dragon is the 39th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume ten of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".
plainText:
Volume 39: Renegade Dragon is the 39th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume ten of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
Lady faces a new Pokémon battle challenge when she must swap her Pokémon with her opponent and fight with rented Pokémon. Meanwhile, the Battle Frontier begins to suffer from a mysterious communications malfunction... What does it signify?

Then, Dia and Pearl set out to visit several Legendary Pokémon of the Sinnoh region. Will they be able to protect them from Team Galactic?

==Important events==
 
Charon takes control of and defeats Buck and , causing them to be hospitalized.
The Pokémon Association enlist the Elite Four to decipher Charon's notebook.
and go on a journey to find the Legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh and protect them from Charon.
Diamond and Pearl recruit .
Paka and Uji are confirmed to be alive and well inside of the Distortion World.
enters the Sinnoh region, in Eterna City.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None

===Evolutions===
No Pokémon evolve in this volume.

==Battle Frontier battles==
